title: E0095: Insecure Comparison
plain_english: Comparing secrets (passwords, tokens, API keys, signatures) using `==` or `===` instead of `hash_equals()` can create a timing side-channel that attackers can exploit.
why_matters: PHP's `==` operator returns early on the first mismatched byte. Attackers can measure response times to: - Guess secrets one character at a time - Bypass authentication by guessing API tokens - Recover signing keys or other secrets
what_it_checks: `==` or `===` comparisons where one operand is a secret-like variable (`token`, `secret`, `key`, `password`, `hash`, `signature`, `mac`, `hmac`)
Both operands must be strings for the timing issue to apply
